description: The Department for Environment and Water publishes a baseline inventory of South Australian levees and embankments. The provider combined existing topographic sources with a desktop assessment of field and survey information, high-resolution LiDAR, aerial photography and stakeholder feedback. The metadata describes both contextual and levee-specific information where available. The mapped defences can provide asset locations for flood exposure studies. Their present condition, crest elevations and performance during floods are not established by the catalogue description. Data.SA lists Shapefile, GeoJSON and compressed KML distributions under CC BY 4.0, with public access. Only catalogue metadata and file headers were inspected. Spatial resolution, attribute definitions and observation currency remain unverified. The Data.SA catalogue record provides the discovery context.
